propositions: bug_trends lens must expose five dimensions (close_class-by-month, detected_by distribution, open-bug age percentiles, caused_by fan-in, time-to-close percentiles) registered via standard metrics registry pattern
Pre-convention bugs lacking close_class must be surfaced as an explicit MISSING labeled cohort, never silently dropped or merged with other classes

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close transition timestamp within CLI range; stock dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by, fan-in) measure current store state and ignore range
Sparse or absent detected_by field must degrade that dimension to unavailable without affecting other dimensions
Empty store or unavailable data must report 'unavailable' state per registry convention, never crash or produce empty-implies-healthy results
